enriched_activities.desc: Lie on the bed on the right side with the head on the pillow. Pull the duvet up to the shoulders. Close the eyes. Roll onto the back. Breathe slowly. Turn onto the left side. Pull the duvet back over the shoulder. Adjust the pillow with the left hand. Remain still for a long stretch. Roll onto the right side again. Push the duvet down to the waist. Pull the duvet back up. Turn the head to the other side on the pillow. Bend the knees. Straighten the legs. Turn the body to face the wall. Remain motionless. Shift the arm under the pillow. Keep the eyes closed and continue sleeping until the phone alarm sounds at 06:45.

enriched_activities.activity: Shower, brushing teeth and getting dressed for the day (bathroom free: Member 1 finished at 06:35 and Member 3 starts at 07:25)
enriched_activities.desc: Sit up on the bed. Reach out the right hand to the phone on the nightstand. Press the alarm button to stop it. Swing the legs off the bed. Stand up. Walk to the bedroom door. Open the door. Walk down the hallway to the bathroom. Push the bathroom door open. Turn on the bathroom light switch. Turn on the tap of the shower. Adjust the water temperature with the handle. Step into the shower. Wet the hair and body. Pick up the shampoo bottle. Squeeze shampoo into the palm. Rub shampoo into the hair. Rinse the hair under the water. Pick up the soap. Rub soap over the arms, shoulders, chest, stomach and legs. Rinse the body. Turn off the tap. Step out of the shower. Take the towel from the hook. Rub the towel over the hair. Wipe the face, arms, chest, back and legs dry. Wrap the towel around the body. Pick up the toothbrush from the holder. Pick up the toothpaste tube. Squeeze toothpaste onto the bristles. Brush the teeth up and down. Spit into the sink. Turn on the tap. Rinse the mouth with water. Turn off the tap. Rinse the toothbrush under the water. Place the toothbrush back into the holder. Put the toothpaste tube back on the shelf. Wipe the face with the towel. Walk to the bedroom. Open the wardrobe door. Take out a shirt, trousers and underwear. Put on the underwear. Put on the trousers. Put on the shirt. Button up the shirt. Pick up the socks. Pull the socks onto both feet. Put on the shoes. Tie the shoelaces. Pick up the backpack. Walk out of the bedroom and close the door.

enriched_activities.activity: Preparing and eating breakfast together with Member 1
enriched_activities.desc: Walk into the kitchen carrying the backpack. Place the backpack on the floor beside the counter. Say 'Good morning' to Member 1. Open the refrigerator door. Take out the milk and eggs. Place them on the counter. Close the refrigerator door. Pick up the frying pan from the cupboard. Place the pan on the induction cooker. Press the power button on the induction cooker. Pick up the oil bottle. Pour oil into the pan. Crack two eggs against the edge of the bowl. Pour the eggs into the pan. Pick up the spatula. Stir the eggs in the pan. Pick up a plate. Slide the eggs onto the plate with the spatula. Press the power button to turn off the induction cooker. Pick up two slices of bread. Place them in the toaster. Press the toaster lever down. Wait for the toast to pop up. Take the toast out of the toaster. Place the toast on the plate. Sit down at the table across from Member 1. Pick up the fork. Eat the eggs and toast. Pick up the cup. Pour milk into the cup. Drink the milk. Talk with Member 1 about the lecture timetable. Stand up. Carry the plate and fork to the sink. Rinse the plate and fork under the tap. Place them in the dish rack. Wipe the table with a cloth. Pick up the backpack.

enriched_activities.activity: Commuting to university campus (Member 1 departs at the same time)
enriched_activities.desc: Walk out of the front door with the backpack on the back. Say 'See you later' to Member 1. Walk together with Member 1 along the footpath to the bus stop. Stand at the bus stop. Take the phone out of the pocket. Check the bus arrival time on the phone screen. Put the phone back into the pocket. Step onto the bus when it arrives. Tap the transport card on the card reader. Walk down the aisle. Sit down on an empty seat. Place the backpack on the lap. Look out of the window. Take the phone out again. Scroll through the lecture notes on the phone screen. Put the phone back into the pocket when the stop is announced. Stand up. Pick up the backpack. Walk to the bus door. Step off the bus. Walk along the campus path to the lecture building.

enriched_activities.activity: Attending Bachelor of Commerce and IT lectures and tutorials
enriched_activities.desc: Walk into the lecture hall. Sit down at a desk in the middle row. Take the laptop out of the backpack. Open the laptop lid. Press the power button. Type the login password on the keyboard. Open the lecture slides file. Take the notebook and pen out of the backpack. Write the lecture title in the notebook. Look at the projector screen. Type notes on the laptop keyboard. Raise the hand to ask a question. Lower the hand. Write more notes in the notebook. Turn the notebook page. Open the tutorial exercise file on the laptop. Type data into the spreadsheet. Copy and paste rows of data. Save the file with the keyboard shortcut. Close the laptop lid. Pack the laptop, notebook and pen into the backpack. Stand up. Walk to the next classroom. Sit down at a new desk. Take the laptop out again. Open the exercise brief on the screen. Discuss the task with the student next to me. Type the group answer onto the shared document. Close the laptop. Pack up the bag.

Walk to the campus food court. Stand in the queue at the food counter. Point to the rice and chicken dish. Pick up a tray. Place the plate on the tray. Pick up a bottle of water. Place it on the tray. Walk to the payment counter. Take the bank card out of the wallet. Tap the card on the card reader. Put the card back into the wallet. Carry the tray to an empty table. Sit down on the chair. Pick up the fork. Eat the rice and chicken. Pick up the bottle. Twist the cap open. Drink the water. Twist the cap closed. Pick up the fork again. Finish the meal. Stand up. Carry the tray to the return rack. Place the plate and fork on the rack. Walk out of the food court.

enriched_activities.activity: Studying in the library and attending afternoon classes
enriched_activities.desc: Walk into the campus library. Sit down at an empty desk near the power point. Take the laptop out of the backpack. Open the laptop lid. Press the power button. Plug the charger into the power point. Plug the charger cable into the laptop. Type the login password. Open the assignment document. Read the question on the screen. Type the answer paragraphs on the keyboard. Open the browser. Search for a journal article. Download the PDF file. Read the PDF on the screen. Copy a paragraph into the assignment document. Type a citation in the reference list. Save the document. Stand up. Walk to the bookshelf. Take a textbook off the shelf. Walk back to the desk. Sit down. Open the textbook. Read two pages. Close the textbook. Stand up. Return the book to the shelf. Walk back to the desk. Sit down. Close the assignment document. Pack the laptop and charger into the backpack. Stand up. Walk to the afternoon lecture room. Sit down at a desk. Take the notebook and pen out. Write notes during the lecture. Raise the hand to answer a question. Write more notes. Close the notebook at the end of the class. Pack the notebook and pen into the backpack.

Walk out of the lecture building. Walk along the campus path to the bus stop. Stand at the bus stop. Take the phone out of the pocket. Check the bus timetable on the screen. Put the phone back into the pocket. Step onto the bus. Tap the transport card on the card reader. Walk down the aisle. Sit down on an empty seat. Place the backpack on the lap. Take out the earphones. Put the earphones into both ears. Take the phone out. Open a podcast on the phone. Listen while looking out of the window. Pull one earphone out when the stop is announced. Stand up. Pick up the backpack. Walk to the bus door. Step off the bus. Walk along the footpath to the house. Open the front door with the key. Close the door behind.

enriched_activities.activity: Cooking and eating dinner (joined by Member 1 until 17:55 and Member 2 from 17:45)
enriched_activities.desc: Walk into the kitchen. Place the backpack on the floor beside the counter. Open the refrigerator door. Take out the vegetables, tofu and eggs. Close the refrigerator door. Place the items on the counter. Pick up a knife from the drawer. Pick up the chopping board. Place the chopping board on the counter. Cut the vegetables into slices with the knife. Push the slices into a bowl. Pick up the wok. Place the wok on the induction cooker. Press the power button. Pour oil into the wok. Pour the vegetables into the wok. Pick up the spatula. Stir the vegetables. Add salt and soy sauce from the bottles. Stir again. Say 'Dinner is nearly ready' to Member 1. Pick up a plate. Slide the vegetables onto the plate. Turn off the induction cooker. Place two plates and chopsticks on the table. Sit down at the table. Say 'Hi' to Member 2 who joins at 17:45. Pick up the chopsticks. Eat the rice and vegetables. Talk with Member 2 about the day. Pick up the cup. Drink water. Finish the meal. Stand up. Carry the plates to the sink. Rinse the plates under the tap. Place them in the dish rack.

Walk into the living room. Pick up the TV remote from the coffee table. Press the power button on the remote. Sit down on the sofa. Point the remote at the TV. Press the channel button. Watch the news programme on the screen. Press the volume button to lower the sound. Put the remote on the sofa armrest. Lean back on the sofa. Take the phone out of the pocket. Open a social media app. Scroll through the feed with the thumb. Put the phone on the coffee table. Pick up the remote again. Press the channel button. Watch the next programme. Pick up the phone again. Check messages. Stand up at the end of the programme. Press the power button on the remote to turn off the TV. Place the remote back on the coffee table.

enriched_activities.activity: Conducting online tutoring sessions using the computer
enriched_activities.desc: Walk into Bedroom 4. Close the bedroom door. Sit down on the chair at the desk. Press the power button on the computer. Turn on the desk lamp switch. Wait for the computer to start. Type the login password on the keyboard. Open the video meeting application. Plug the headset into the computer. Put the headset on the head. Adjust the microphone position. Open the tutoring materials file. Join the first student's video session. Say 'Hello, can you hear me?' to the student. Share the screen with the student. Point at the maths problem on the screen with the cursor. Explain the steps by speaking into the microphone. Type the worked solution into the shared document. Ask the student to try the next problem. Wait while the student types. Correct the answer in the document. End the first session. Open the next student's session link. Repeat the explanation with the new student. Write notes in the lesson log file. Check the time on the screen. End the last session. Take off the headset. Place the headset on the desk. Close the video meeting application. Stretch both arms above the head. Stand up from the chair.

enriched_activities.activity: Making a hot drink and having a snack (kitchen free before Member 3's dinner at 21:20)
enriched_activities.desc: Walk from Bedroom 4 to the kitchen. Open the cupboard door. Take out the mug. Place the mug on the counter. Pick up the kettle. Fill the kettle with water from the tap. Place the kettle on its base. Press the kettle power switch. Open the cupboard door again. Take out the biscuit packet. Open the packet. Take out three biscuits. Place them on a small plate. Close the packet. Put the packet back into the cupboard. Close the cupboard door. Pick up the tea bag box. Take out one tea bag. Place the tea bag into the mug. Pour the boiled water from the kettle into the mug. Pick up a spoon. Stir the tea. Place the spoon on the counter. Pick up the plate of biscuits and the mug. Carry them to the table. Sit down. Dip a biscuit into the tea. Eat the biscuits. Drink the tea. Stand up. Carry the mug and plate to the sink. Rinse the mug and plate under the tap. Place them in the dish rack. Wipe the counter with a cloth. Walk out of the kitchen.

enriched_activities.activity: Doing freelance analyst work on the computer
enriched_activities.desc: Walk into Bedroom 4. Close the bedroom door. Sit down on the chair at the desk. Press the space bar to wake the computer screen. Type the login password. Open the spreadsheet file from the client email. Read the data columns on the screen. Type formulas into the cells. Copy the formula down the column. Click the chart button. Insert a bar chart into the sheet. Adjust the chart size with the mouse. Open the client brief document. Read the requirements on the screen. Switch back to the spreadsheet. Clean the data rows by deleting the blanks. Save the file with the keyboard shortcut. Open the email application. Attach the finished spreadsheet file. Type a short message to the client. Click the send button. Open the next client's data file. Type the analysis notes into the document. Check the numbers with the calculator on the screen. Save the document. Lean back on the chair. Rotate the neck left and right. Stretch both arms forward. Close the spreadsheet and document windows. Turn off the desk lamp. Stand up from the chair.

enriched_activities.activity: Showering and completing night routine (bathroom free: Member 3 finished at 22:20 and Member 1 starts at 23:00)
enriched_activities.desc: Walk from Bedroom 4 to the bathroom. Push the bathroom door open. Turn on the bathroom light switch. Turn on the shower tap. Adjust the water temperature with the handle. Step into the shower. Wet the hair and body under the water. Pick up the shampoo bottle. Squeeze shampoo into the palm. Rub shampoo into the hair. Rinse the hair. Pick up the soap. Rub soap over the arms, chest, stomach and legs. Rinse the body. Turn off the tap. Step out of the shower. Take the towel from the hook. Rub the towel over the hair. Wipe the body dry. Wrap the towel around the waist. Pick up the toothbrush from the holder. Pick up the toothpaste tube. Squeeze toothpaste onto the bristles. Brush the teeth. Spit into the sink. Turn on the tap. Rinse the mouth. Turn off the tap. Rinse the toothbrush under the water. Place the toothbrush back into the holder. Put the toothpaste tube back on the shelf. Pick up the pyjamas from the hook. Put on the pyjama top and bottoms. Hang the towel back on the hook. Turn off the light. Open the door and walk out to Bedroom 4.

enriched_activities.activity: Winding down on the phone and falling asleep
enriched_activities.desc: Walk into Bedroom 4. Close the bedroom door. Place the phone on the nightstand. Pull back the duvet. Lie down on the bed. Pull the duvet over the body. Pick up the phone from the nightstand. Unlock the screen with the thumb. Open a video app. Scroll through the video list. Tap a video to play. Watch the screen. Scroll to the next video. Open a messaging app. Read the incoming messages. Type a short reply with both thumbs. Send the message. Put the phone down on the nightstand face down. Turn off the bedside lamp. Turn onto the right side. Adjust the pillow with the left hand. Close the eyes. Turn onto the back. Pull the duvet up to the chin. Remain still and fall asleep.
